name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Your Perpetuus API key, starting with `ppt_`. In Perpetuus, go to **Settings → API Tokens e MCP → Conectar sua IA (MCP) → Conectar editor → Conectar novo editor**, choose the validity and the `crm:write` scope (it includes `crm:read`). The key is shown only once.

name: baseUrl
label: API base URL
help: Leave the default (`https://api.perpetuus.com.br/api`) unless Perpetuus support gave you another address. It must start with `https://` and must not end with a slash.
